evidence: Modifies core script and transaction primitives in src/script/ and src/primitives/transaction.h, rewriting CScriptWitness storage and block/tx deserialization bounds.
rationale: Addresses validation memory exhaustion where pathological 4 MB blocks consume over 100 MiB of memory and 280 ms in deserialization time. Peak memory drops to 7.8 MiB and deserialization time falls to 18.7 ms, eliminating an adversarial resource-exhaustion vector.
